description:
This figure is a scatter plot comparing the ImageNet-1K classification accuracy of various convolutional neural networks (ConvNets) and vision transformers. The x-axis represents the diameter of the model, and the y-axis represents the ImageNet-1K accuracy. Each bubble's area is proportional to the FLOPs of a variant in a model family. The ConvNets are represented by solid circles, and the vision transformers are represented by open circles. The ConvNets include ResNet, DeiT, and ConvNeXt, while the vision transformers include ViT and Swin Transformer.

The main point of the figure is that a standard ConvNet model can achieve the same level of scalability as hierarchical vision Transformers while being much simpler in design. The figure shows that ConvNets can achieve similar or better accuracy than vision transformers with fewer parameters and computational complexity.

caption: Figure 2. We modernize a standard ConvNet (ResNet) towards the design of a hierarchical vision Transformer (Swin), without introducing any attention-based modules. The foreground bars are model accuracies in the ResNet-50/Swin-T FLOP regime; results for the ResNet-200/Swin-B regime are shown with the gray bars. A hatched bar means the modification is not adopted. Detailed results for both regimes are in the appendix. Many Transformer architectural choices can be incorporated in a ConvNet, and they lead to increasingly better performance. In the end, our pure ConvNet model, named ConvNeXt, can outperform the Swin Transformer.
description:
This figure is a bar chart comparing the performance of various convolutional neural network (ConvNet) architectures. It shows the ImageNet Top-1 accuracy percentages for different models, with ResNet-50/Swin-T FLOP regime results in the foreground and ResNet-200/Swin-B regime results in the background. The models include ResNet-50/200, ResNetXt, Inverted Bottleneck, Large Kernel, ReLU-GELU, Micro Design, ConvNeXt-T/B, and Swin-T/B. The highest accuracy is achieved by ConvNeXt-T/B at 82.0%, while the lowest is ResNet-50/200 at 78.8%.
